notes.title: ⚖️ Balance Changes v1.6
notes.content:
[list]
[*] [b]MAIN BUILDING[/b] - a new structure that players must build if they wish to purchase [b]more than 50 plots[/b]. At level 1 it provides +50 plots, at level 2 it provides +150 plots, and at level 3 it provides +350 plots. The [b]limit is 3[/b] of such buildings. Once the first MAIN BUILDING is constructed, [b]THE PLAYER’S DEFEAT CONDITION CHANGES - the opponent only needs to conquer all of the player’s MAIN BUILDINGS to conquer that player[/b]. Capturing this building also grants the conqueror several surrounding plots with structures. After construction, [b]the building cannot be demolished by its owner - it remains until destroyed by an enemy[/b].
[*] [b]IMPERIAL CARGO FREIGHTER WITH DEFENSE[/b] - by the Emperor’s decree, additional cargo freighters will now arrive equipped with defenses, including DEFENSE TOWERS and CHARGING STATIONS filled with armies.
[*] [b]POST-PROCESSING[/b] - new graphical effects have been added for light reflections and contrast adjustments, making the visuals more vibrant. This option can be disabled in the settings, as it consumes some processing power.
[*] [b]MAX FPS SETTINGS[/b] - players can now set a maximum FPS limit in the settings. Lower frame rates will reduce CPU and GPU workload.
[*] [b]BUG FIXES[/b] – various other issues have been resolved.
[/list]

notes.title: UPDATE v1.52
notes.content:
[list]
[*] [b]DISPLAYED RANGE[/b] - when sending a tank or plane to a charging station, you will now see not only the charging stations themselves, but also the range covered by tank and aircraft factories. This will be displayed in the same way as defense tower ranges, missile launch ranges, or the attack range of a tile or building.
[*] [b]CLEARER TARGETS[/b] - missile targets will stand out visually, and overall selection will be clearer.
[/list]

notes.title: ⚖️ Balance Changes v1.5
notes.content:
[list]
[*][b]Imperial Cargo Freighter[/b] – The Emperor, having decided to assist the player, will occasionally send his cargo freighter, which, once conquered by the player, will grant some resources.
[*][b]The Atom Missile (Nuke)[/b] will now not only destroy several buildings but also [b]remove the player's ownership[/b] of the land where radiation appears.
[*]When the [b]offline shield[/b] appears after an attack while the player is offline, [b]it will no longer disappear upon their return[/b] – it will remain active for its full intended duration.
[*][b]Improved night view with more lights.[/b]
[*][b]Other bug fixes.[/b]
[/list]

notes.title: UPDATE v1.4
notes.content:
[list]
[*] [b]PLANET SELECTION.[/b] You will now see all available planet options where you can play, including player count, new player protection times, all shields, and Steam friends playing on planets that are still open to new players.
[*] [b]FAST PLANET.[/b] A new fast-paced planet has been added, where production is 10 times faster, army training and loading is 3 times faster, and building construction is 2 times faster. However, the starting shield and new player protection time will be significantly shorter.
[*] Various bugs have also been fixed.
[/list]

notes.title: ⚖️ Balance Changes v1.3
notes.content:
[list]
[*][b]Emperor's Progressive Tax[/b] introduced when purchasing new plots.
This helps slow down rapid expansion and prevents blocking other players.
Once you own a decent number of plots, it's more cost-effective to upgrade buildings rather than keep buying land.
[*][b]Improved the tutorial[/b] — new players will now receive more helpful information at the start.
[*]Important bug fixes implemented.
[/list]

notes.title: ⚖️ Balance Changes v1.2
notes.content:
[list]
[*] [b]New default mode: [i]Offline Shield[/i][/b]
[i]  - activates for 8h if 20% or more of your buildings are destroyed while offline.[/i]
[i]  - deactivates upon login.[/i]
[i] 💡 (You can also choose to land on a planet without this shield if you prefer.)[/i]
[*] [b]Added the option to find matches with or without friends.[/b]
[*] [b]Reduced the maximum number of players per match.[/b]
[*] [b]Bug fixes.[/b]
[/list]

notes.title: Balance Changes v1.1
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Increased [b]gather rate[/b] on Planet Alpha [i](1.5x)[/i], Beta [i](1.25x)[/i]
[*] Reduced Start Protection time from 48 hours to 24 hours
[*] Reduced Accepting new players time from 48 hours to 24 hours
[*] Shield time reduces with more land bought beyond 19 tiles[i] (-20min)[/i]
[*] Bug fixes
[/list]
